video_title: Perk Declares Wemby The BEST Player In The NBA & GOES OFF On Julius Randle

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Wemby is the most dominant and best offensive player
quotes.quote: He's the most dominant and he's the best player in the NBA. And I would, I would if I was on the side of y'all, I would literally throw some paper at both of y'all with a pen and tell me, hey, design a game plan to stop him, to stop him offensively. Tell Allie, here go your pen and paper. Channing, draw up a game plan and tell me how you're going to stop him offensively. We have never seen anything... that's the only, the only thing that's stopping Wemby is Wemby. If you want him to set a pick and roll to the basket, just throw it up. If he want to come down and he full steam ahead with an in and out between spin to a dunk, get the out the way. If you want to try to, you know, hey man, I'm hanging out in the corner, all of a sudden here comes a wide pin down for a 7'5 guy, that's Wemby. If you go under, guess what? I'm lighting your ass up from the trey ball.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Wemby is the greatest and most unique defender ever seen
quotes.quote: Let's swing it on to the other. Defensively, I've never seen nothing in my life like that on the defensive side of the basketball. He is the greatest defender I've ever seen with my own two eyes. I've never seen someone that anchors a defense the way that he does. I never seen someone that was able to jump up, attack, try to block somebody's shot or block it at the rim with one arm, but while in the air, taking away a drop-off pass. So think about this for a second. He's up in the air contesting a floater or a shot while the other arm is roaming free. So you don't even have a drop-off pass, which causes a turnover. And this mean motherfucker with this evil smirk grin that he's giving is just all the smoke. I know I'm 7'5, I know I'm taller than you, I'm skilled and it's fuck you.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Edwards playing through two significant knee injuries
quotes.quote: On the flip side of it, it's a motherfucker who got a hatred for losing too, Anthony Edwards. And by the way, you talk about giving somebody some props? Two fucking hurt knees. Runner's knee on one and fucking hyperextension on the other one. He's out there averaging 31, I believe, Allie, how much? Over 30 in this series. Help a brother out.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Julius Randle's jealousy and competitiveness drives his game
quotes.quote: Julius Randle. If I'm Julius Randle, I'm always watching the team that traded me. And I'm saying to myself, oh, y'all think y'all doing good without me? I got to go show out. Because guess what? It's okay to be jealous. I keep telling people that. Like, it's okay if Anthony Edwards is jealous of SGA's success and want what he has. Wemby is, I'm going to tell you that straight up, Wemby is jealous of all the great who got something that he want. And that's what brings that passion and that competitiveness that he has because he want everything. You take him to the buffet, you better believe he ain't ordering no salad. He getting it all. He want the meat, potatoes and everything. He want every fucking thing.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Julius Randle's poor body language and decision-making on offense
quotes.quote: Julius Randle, my Texas brother. Texas boy for life. Hey bro, first of all, fix your fucking body language out there. That, no, seriously bro. That is the worst. It is demoralizing, bro. That drains and sucks the energy of your fucking team, man. Like, fix your body language. The hanging of the head, the bad fucking turnovers, the isolation ball and you see a double team coming but you're trying to score over three people. Move the ball. What the fuck are you doing?

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden McDaniels needs to get back to his true self
quotes.quote: Jaden McDaniels, last thing I'm going to say. I gave you the MVP of the first round. I said if I had to give an MVP award, it was going to Jaden McDaniels. He took that. He did. But you've been getting your ass bust in this series. They've been going at you like De'Aaron Fox, Dillon Brooks, whoever you've been going, you've been in foul trouble and they've been giving you that work. Get back to who the fuck you are.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gobert's offensive role and the Timberwolves-Nuggets series outcome

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: Anthony Edwards need help. Rudy, I don't know what you need to do. If they still got that powder or that...

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: He's overachieving. Rudy got his hands full, brother.

text_blocks.speaker: Allie LaForce
text_blocks.text: I want to say, Rudy went from Nikola Jokic in round one to now...

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: No, no, leave Rudy alone. I need Rudy to catch and finish. Anthony Edwards so much...

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: You're asking him too much. To catch the ball? No, have you ever seen him put the basketball?

text_blocks.speaker: Allie LaForce
text_blocks.text: I just want to ask you guys if the series ends tonight or if Minnesota can force a Game 7.

text_blocks.speaker: Allie LaForce
text_blocks.text: I love when you guys get along and you guys...

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: Channing, you want a little bet on this one?

text_blocks.speaker: Allie LaForce
text_blocks.text: Put a bet and then we're going to break. What are we betting?

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: Case of wine, pair of Jays, let's do it. I got Minnesota tonight.
